steps.sql: SELECT NCHAR(65) AS latin,NCHAR(8364) AS euro,NCHAR(65535) AS last_unit,NCHAR(65536) AS out_of_range,NCHAR(NULL) AS absent,ISNULL(NCHAR(NULL),'') AS padded; SELECT NCHAR(65) AS empty_result WHERE 1=0; BEGIN TRY SELECT NCHAR(N'2147483648'); END TRY BEGIN CATCH SELECT ERROR_NUMBER() AS text_overflow; END CATCH

SELECT ISNULL(DATENAME(month,CAST(NULL AS DATETIME2(7))),N'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789') AS shortened,ISNULL(DATENAME(month,CAST(NULL AS DATETIME2(7))),42) AS converted,ISNULL(DATENAME(month,CAST(NULL AS DATETIME2(7))),NULL) AS absent

SELECT DATENAME(month,'2026-01-01') AS month_name,COALESCE(DATENAME(month,CAST(NULL AS DATETIME2(7))),DATENAME(month,'2026-02-01')) AS fallback; SELECT DATENAME(month,CAST(NULL AS DATETIME2(7))) AS absent WHERE 1=0

SELECT CHAR(65) AS c,CHAR(NULL) AS cn,SPACE(3) AS s,SPACE(0) AS empty_space,UNICODE(N'🦆') AS code; SELECT CHAR(65) AS mixed UNION ALL SELECT SPACE(3) UNION ALL SELECT NULL; SELECT COALESCE(CHAR(NULL),SPACE(4)) AS co,IIF(1=0,SPACE(7),CHAR(65)) AS conditional; SELECT ISNULL(CHAR(NULL),SPACE(5)) AS replacement,ISNULL(CHAR(NULL),SPACE(0)) AS padded
